coverage: SIGKILL after prepared checkpoint and after committed effect; resumed work does not duplicate the database effect

Bounded retry, exponential backoff, cancellation, logical-volume wait without attempt loss

User/app/consumer isolation, revoked sessions/grants, native roles denied core tables and SQL-like text retained as data

known_risks: Fixture authentication, volume inventory and authorization remain synthetic
Task leases are database-local coordination, not distributed pool fencing

At-least-once delivery requires idempotent external consumers; no notification channel or scheduling calendar
Global event counter serializes transitions; no large-scale throughput or retention benchmark
Job and consumer IDs/idempotency keys are currently globally unique; callers should use opaque unique request IDs
No real volume unplug, power-loss proof, cross-Mac test or macOS15 runtime result
No OS sandbox, production authentication, Keychain/helper/SMB authorization or production cutover
